# SYSLight Reusable Prompt Templates
**Established July 2026**

This directory contains reusable prompt templates to guide AI assistants when generating full pages, layout sections, components, or performing code audits in the SYSLight codebase.

---

## 🗃️ Templates Index

### 1. [UI Review Agent Prompt](file:///e:/projects/sys/docs/templates/ui-review-agent.md)
System rules and scorecard layouts to execute automated reviews of new front-end developments against WCAG AA and Design System guidelines.

### 2. [Page-Level Templates](file:///e:/projects/sys/docs/templates/pages-templates.md)
Prompt configurations to build core viewpages:
- Landing Page
- Dashboard
- Admin Page
- Analytics
- Settings
- Profile
- Authentication
- Pricing

### 3. [Section-Level Templates](file:///e:/projects/sys/docs/templates/sections-templates.md)
Prompt rules to design component sections:
- Hero Section
- Features Section
- Testimonials
- FAQ
- Contact

### 4. [Component-Level Templates](file:///e:/projects/sys/docs/templates/components-templates.md)
Prompt scripts to build modular interface widgets:
- Forms
- Tables
- Charts
- Modals
- Sidebars
- Cards
